files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- **Leave the watch date empty**: a new setting, *Settings → Adding titles → Fill in today's
  date as the watch date*. When it is off, the date field starts empty when you add a movie
  or TV show, mark a watchlist movie as watched or log a viewing, so titles you watched long
  ago don't get today's date. A movie saved with an empty date still counts as watched, with
  a viewing without date. On by default. (#137)
- **Favourite from the overview**: the heart on a movie or TV show tile in the lists now
  switches the favourite on and off without opening the title. An empty heart shows when you
  point at a tile (always on touch screens). Only with edit rights in the library. (#136)

### Changed
- Movie and TV show tiles: the title is now the button that opens the title, and the heart is
  a separate button next to it, so keyboard and screen reader users reach both. A click
  anywhere else on the tile still opens it. (#136)

### Fixed
- Clearing the watch date of a TV show now removes it; before, the old date stayed (and a
  show saved without a date got today's). (#137)
- **A TV show could be added twice**: moving a show from the watchlist to your TV shows
  imported it again when it was already there. It now opens the show you already have and
  says so; clicking twice (or adding the same show in two tabs at once) also gives one show.
  Adding a show you already track to the watchlist shows a hint. Shows that were added twice
  before stay until you delete the extra copy. (#147)
- A TMDB answer "not found" for the trailer and streaming offers of an obscure or removed title is
  no longer logged as an error in the Nextcloud log; the page behaves as before.

### Upgrade note
- Adds a small table, `moviedb_import_locks` (short-lived locks that keep a TV show from being imported
  twice at once). The migration runs with the normal app update (`occ upgrade`); nothing else to do.
